 |eyebrow=EDFM // Odyssey Engineer

{{Engineer infobox}}

'''Jude Navarro''' is an Odyssey Engineer based at '''Marshall's Drift''' in the [[Aurai]] system. He is an independent starting Engineer and does not require a referral from another Engineer.<ref name="inara-jude">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/26/ Jude Navarro — Engineer], Inara.</ref>

Jude specialises in combat-oriented suit and handheld-weapon modifications. He provides [[Added Melee Damage]], [[Damage Resistance]], [[Extra Ammo Capacity]], [[Magazine Size]], and [[Reload Speed]].<ref name="inara-jude" />

{{Field note|Jude is one of '''three independent starting Odyssey Engineers in the Bubble''', alongside [[Hero Ferrari]] and [[Domino Green]]. All three are listed as common knowledge and can be pursued without first unlocking another Odyssey Engineer.<ref name="inara-engineers">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineers/ Engineers], Inara.</ref>}}

Odyssey Engineering is separate from ship Engineering. Suits and handheld weapons have equipment grades and modification slots rather than the Grade 1–5 Engineer-reputation progression used by ship Engineers.

== Location ==

* '''System:''' [[Aurai]]
* '''Settlement:''' [[Marshall's Drift]]
* '''Body:''' Aurai 1 a
* '''Engineer type:''' Odyssey Engineer
* '''Prerequisite Engineer:''' None
* '''System permit required:''' No

Marshall's Drift is a surface Engineer base on '''Aurai 1 a''', approximately 1,600 Ls from the system arrival point.<ref name="inara-marshalls-drift">[https://inara.cz/elite/station-outfitting/241978/ Marshall's Drift — Station], Inara.</ref>

== How to Discover Jude Navarro ==

Jude Navarro is '''common knowledge''' and does not require a referral from another Engineer.<ref name="inara-jude" />

He can therefore be pursued independently of the other Odyssey Engineer branches.

The three independent starting branches in the Bubble are:

<pre>
Hero Ferrari
└── Wellington Beck
    └── Uma Laszlo

Jude Navarro
└── Terra Velasquez
    └── Oden Geiger

Domino Green
└── Kit Fowler
    └── Yarden Bond
</pre>

{{Field note|The starting Engineers do not need to be completed in any particular order. Progress with Hero Ferrari, Jude Navarro, and Domino Green can be worked on independently.}}

== How to Receive an Invitation ==

There is no separate invitation requirement for Jude Navarro.

His access requirement is simply to complete '''10 Restore or Reactivation missions'''.<ref name="inara-jude" />

== How to Unlock Jude Navarro ==

Unlock requirements summary:
* Repeat until '''10 qualifying missions''' have been completed.
{{Important|The requirement is for '''10 completed Restore or Reactivation missions'''. Simply turning on the power at an unrelated abandoned settlement is not the documented Engineer requirement.}}
{{Tip|These missions can also provide opportunities to search powered-down settlements for Odyssey Engineering materials, making Jude's unlock a useful time to begin building a general stockpile of Goods, Assets, and Data.}}

For the complete step-by-step process, see [[Unlocking Jude Navarro]].

== Odyssey Engineering at Jude Navarro ==

Odyssey Engineering works differently from ship Engineering.

Suits and handheld weapons have an '''equipment grade'''. Higher equipment grades provide additional modification slots:

{| class="wikitable"
! Equipment grade
! Modification slots
|-
| Grade 1
| 0
|-
| Grade 2
| 1
|-
| Grade 3
| 2
|-
| Grade 4
| 3
|-
| Grade 5
| 4
|}

Jude installs individual modifications into those available slots.

His modifications do '''not''' progress through Grade 1–5 Engineer reputation.

{{Important|A Grade 5 Dominator Suit does not receive a "Grade 5 Damage Resistance" modification. Grade 5 describes the suit itself and gives it four modification slots; Damage Resistance occupies one of those slots as a single permanent modification.}}

See [[Odyssey Engineering]] for equipment grades, upgrading, modification slots, Engineering materials, and Pioneer Supplies.

== Available Engineering ==

Jude currently provides five Odyssey modifications.<ref name="inara-jude" />

== Added Melee Damage ==

'''Added Melee Damage''' substantially increases damage dealt by both unarmed attacks and melee strikes performed with a handheld weapon.<ref name="inara-jude" />

The current modifiers are:

* '''+150% weapon melee damage multiplier'''
* '''+150% fists melee damage multiplier'''<ref name="inara-jude" />

The current recipe is:

* 5 [[Combat Training Material]]
* 5 [[Combatant Performance]]
* 5 [[Epinephrine]]
* 8 [[Micro Thrusters]]
* '''500,000 CR'''<ref name="inara-jude" />

Other Engineers currently providing Added Melee Damage include:

* [[Kit Fowler]]
* [[Eleanor Bresa]]<ref name="inara-jude" />

{{Tip|'''EDFM recommendation:''' Added Melee Damage is a specialised modification rather than a general-purpose suit upgrade.

It can be useful for a build deliberately designed around close-quarters combat, but most Commanders will gain more consistent value from survivability, ammunition, mobility, or utility modifications.}}

Because Odyssey suit modification slots are permanent and limited, consider whether melee combat is genuinely part of the suit's intended role before installing it.

== Damage Resistance ==

'''Damage Resistance''' reduces incoming damage from the four principal on-foot weapon damage types.<ref name="inara-jude" />

The current modifiers are:

* '''+10% kinetic damage reduction'''
* '''+10% thermal damage reduction'''
* '''+10% plasma damage reduction'''
* '''+10% explosive damage reduction'''<ref name="inara-jude" />

The current recipe is:

* 5 [[Weapon Inventory]]
* 5 [[Ballistics Data]]
* 3 [[Titanium Plating]]
* 3 [[Carbon Fibre Plating]]
* 8 [[Epoxy Adhesive]]
* '''750,000 CR'''<ref name="inara-jude" />

Other Engineers currently providing Damage Resistance include:

* [[Uma Laszlo]]
* [[Eleanor Bresa]]<ref name="inara-jude" />

{{Tip|'''EDFM recommendation:''' Damage Resistance is one of Jude's strongest general-purpose modifications for a combat-oriented [[Dominator Suit]].

It improves protection against kinetic, thermal, plasma, and explosive attacks rather than depending on the enemy using one particular damage type.}}

It can also be useful on other suits when increased survivability is worth one of their limited modification slots.

== Extra Ammo Capacity ==

'''Extra Ammo Capacity''' increases the amount of ammunition the suit can carry for its weapons.<ref name="inara-jude" />

The current modifier is:

* '''+50% ammunition capacity'''<ref name="inara-jude" />

The current recipe is:

* 8 [[Recycling Logs]]
* 5 [[Weapon Test Data]]
* 5 [[Production Reports]]
* 3 [[Weapon Component]]
* '''750,000 CR'''<ref name="inara-jude" />

Other Engineers currently providing Extra Ammo Capacity include:

* [[Kit Fowler]]
* [[Eleanor Bresa]]<ref name="inara-jude" />

{{Tip|'''EDFM recommendation:''' Extra Ammo Capacity is particularly useful on a [[Dominator Suit]] used for prolonged surface combat.

The larger ammunition reserve reduces dependence on ammunition crates and allows more engagements before the suit needs to be resupplied.}}

It can also be valuable on suits used for settlement missions where resupply opportunities may be limited.

{{Field note|Extra Ammo Capacity modifies the '''suit's carried ammunition reserve'''. It is separate from [[Magazine Size]], which modifies how many rounds an individual weapon holds before reloading.}}

== Magazine Size ==

'''Magazine Size''' increases the amount of ammunition held in a handheld weapon's magazine.<ref name="inara-jude" />

The resulting magazine capacity depends on the weapon being modified.

The current recipe is:

* 5 [[Weapon Test Data]]
* 3 [[Security Expenses]]
* 3 [[Weapon Component]]
* 3 [[Tungsten Carbide]]
* 5 [[Metal Coil]]
* '''750,000 CR'''<ref name="inara-jude" />

Other Engineers currently providing Magazine Size include:

* [[Kit Fowler]]
* [[Eleanor Bresa]]<ref name="inara-jude" />

{{Tip|'''EDFM recommendation:''' Magazine Size is most useful on weapons whose normal magazine frequently forces a reload at inconvenient points in an engagement.

Its practical value depends heavily on the weapon. A larger magazine can improve sustained fire, but a weapon that already has adequate capacity may benefit more from another modification.}}

Magazine Size can be particularly useful when combined with a suit carrying [[Extra Ammo Capacity]]:

* Magazine Size increases ammunition available '''before each reload'''.
* Extra Ammo Capacity increases the suit's '''total carried reserve'''.

They solve different ammunition limitations.

== Reload Speed ==

'''Reload Speed''' shortens the time required to reload a handheld weapon.<ref name="inara-jude" />

The current recipe is:

* 5 [[Operational Manual]]
* 5 [[Production Reports]]
* 5 [[Combat Training Material]]
* 5 [[Micro Hydraulics]]
* 5 [[Electromagnet]]
* '''500,000 CR'''<ref name="inara-jude" />

Other Engineers currently providing Reload Speed include:

* [[Uma Laszlo]]
* [[Eleanor Bresa]]<ref name="inara-jude" />

{{Tip|'''EDFM recommendation:''' Reload Speed is one of Jude's strongest broadly useful weapon modifications.

Its benefit applies every time the weapon is reloaded and does not depend on a particular target type, body location, or environmental condition.}}

The value of Reload Speed increases on weapons whose normal reload animation creates a significant interruption during combat.

== Engineer Unlock Chain ==

Jude Navarro is an independent starting point in the Odyssey Engineer network.

His branch is:

<pre>
Jude Navarro
└── Terra Velasquez
    └── Oden Geiger
</pre>

[[Terra Velasquez]] is discovered through Jude Navarro.<ref name="inara-terra">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/31/ Terra Velasquez — Engineer], Inara.</ref>

Terra subsequently leads to [[Oden Geiger]].<ref name="inara-oden">[https://inara.cz/elite/engineer/34/ Oden Geiger — Engineer], Inara.</ref>

== Referring Terra Velasquez ==

After Jude Navarro has been unlocked, provide him with '''5 [[Genetic Repair Meds]]''' to receive the referral to [[Terra Velasquez]].<ref name="inara-jude" />

{{Important|The Genetic Repair Meds are '''not required to unlock Jude himself'''.

The two requirements are separate:

* '''Unlock Jude Navarro:''' complete 10 Restore or Reactivation missions.
* '''Discover Terra Velasquez:''' provide Jude with '''5 Genetic Repair Meds'''.}}

== Obtaining Genetic Repair Meds ==

[[Genetic Repair Meds]] are Odyssey '''Goods'''.<ref name="inara-genetic-meds">[https://inara.cz/elite/componentitem/10349/ Genetic Repair Meds — Component], Inara.</ref>

Current material data lists them in several settlement loot pools, including:

* '''MED rooms'''
* '''STO buildings'''
* '''RES buildings'''
* '''IND buildings'''
* '''EXT buildings'''
* '''AGRI buildings'''<ref name="inara-genetic-meds" />

Medical areas are therefore an obvious place to check when searching settlements for them.

{{Tip|Only '''5 Genetic Repair Meds''' are required. Once Jude is unlocked, keep the first five you find if you intend to continue immediately into the Terra Velasquez branch.}}

Because Genetic Repair Meds are physical Odyssey Goods rather than Data, they occupy Goods storage and must be physically provided to Jude.

Once the five units have been handed over, [[Terra Velasquez]] becomes the next Engineer in the branch.<ref name="inara-terra" />

== Increasing Engineer Reputation ==

'''Not applicable to Odyssey Engineers in the same way as ship Engineers.'''

Jude Navarro does not use the Grade 1–5 Engineer-reputation progression found at ship Engineer workshops.

Once Jude has been unlocked, his modifications are available provided that:

* the equipment is compatible;
* the suit or weapon has an unused modification slot; and
* you possess the required Odyssey materials and credits.

The equipment itself is upgraded separately through [[Pioneer Supplies]].

Likewise, Jude's referral to Terra is not triggered by raising an Engineer reputation grade. It is triggered specifically by providing '''5 Genetic Repair Meds'''.<ref name="inara-jude" />

See [[Odyssey Engineering]] for the complete on-foot Engineering system.

== Experimental Effects ==

'''Not applicable.'''

Odyssey suit and handheld-weapon Engineering does not use the separate ship-module [[Experimental Effects]] system.

Jude's five modifications are themselves the permanent modifications installed onto the equipment.

== Blueprint Pinning ==

'''Not applicable.'''

Odyssey modifications cannot be pinned for [[Remote Engineering]] in the same manner as ship Engineering blueprints.

A suit or weapon must be taken to Jude Navarro or another Odyssey Engineer who offers the desired modification.

{{Field note|Unlocking Jude therefore does not make Damage Resistance, Extra Ammo Capacity, Magazine Size, or Reload Speed remotely available from another station.}}

== Recommended Engineering ==

Jude's modification set is particularly useful for combat-oriented equipment.

=== Dominator Suit ==

For a [[Dominator Suit]] intended primarily for surface conflict zones, settlement combat, or combat missions:

{{Tip|'''EDFM recommendation:''' [[Damage Resistance]] and [[Extra Ammo Capacity]] are both strong general-purpose choices.

Damage Resistance improves survivability against all four major on-foot weapon damage types, while Extra Ammo Capacity increases combat endurance by carrying 50% more ammunition.}}

The two modifications complement each other:

* Damage Resistance helps the suit survive longer.
* Extra Ammo Capacity allows the Commander to remain combat-effective longer before resupplying.

[[Added Melee Damage]] is much more specialised and is best reserved for a suit intentionally built around very close-range combat.

=== General-purpose weapon ===

For weapons, Jude offers:

* [[Magazine Size]]
* [[Reload Speed]]

Neither is universally superior.

{{Tip|'''EDFM recommendation:''' [[Reload Speed]] is the safer general-purpose choice when the weapon's reload cycle regularly interrupts combat.

[[Magazine Size]] can be stronger on weapons whose small normal magazine is the more significant limitation.}}

The choice should therefore be made on a weapon-by-weapon basis rather than applying the same modification automatically to every firearm.

=== Combining ammunition modifications ===

A combat build can use both:

* '''Extra Ammo Capacity''' on the suit; and
* '''Magazine Size''' on the weapon.

This increases both total ammunition reserve and ammunition available between reloads.

Alternatively, combining Extra Ammo Capacity with Reload Speed leaves the weapon's magazine unchanged but reduces the interruption each time that magazine is emptied.

== What Jude Cannot Modify ==

Jude currently provides five modification types:

* '''Added Melee Damage''' — suit
* '''Damage Resistance''' — suit
* '''Extra Ammo Capacity''' — suit
* '''Magazine Size''' — weapon
* '''Reload Speed''' — weapon<ref name="inara-jude" />

Other modifications require different Engineers.

Examples include:

* '''Combat Movement Speed:''' [[Terra Velasquez]], [[Yarden Bond]], or [[Baltanos]]
* '''Improved Hip Fire Accuracy:''' [[Terra Velasquez]], [[Yarden Bond]], or [[Baltanos]]
* '''Noise Suppressor:''' [[Hero Ferrari]], [[Terra Velasquez]], or [[Baltanos]]
* '''Faster Handling:''' [[Hero Ferrari]], [[Yarden Bond]], or [[Baltanos]]
* '''Greater Range:''' [[Domino Green]], [[Wellington Beck]], or [[Rosa Dayette]]
* '''Scope:''' [[Wellington Beck]], [[Oden Geiger]], or [[Rosa Dayette]]
* '''Stability:''' [[Domino Green]], [[Oden Geiger]], or [[Rosa Dayette]]
* '''Faster Shield Regen:''' [[Kit Fowler]], [[Uma Laszlo]], or [[Eleanor Bresa]]
* '''Stowed Reloading:''' [[Kit Fowler]], [[Uma Laszlo]], or [[Eleanor Bresa]]
* '''Night Vision:''' [[Oden Geiger]] or [[Yi Shen]]<ref name="inara-engineers" />

See [[Odyssey Engineer Modifications]] for the complete Engineer-by-modification matrix.
